name: JSON Grid
description: Explore and edit JSON as nested grids, DevTools-style trees and source. Copy JSONPath, search, filter and format locally.
releaseNotes: Initial release: editable nested grids and trees, lossless numbers, JSONPath, search/filter, formatting and shared undo/redo.
